scene_sentence_zh: 風掃過的草原上立著白色鹿形石雕，斷角與苔痕在斜陽下拖出細長的影子。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a weathered white marble stag statue upon a low circular plinth in a windswept meadow, one antler broken, lichen gathered in the carved fur, tall dry grass bending around the base, late afternoon sun raking from the left across pale stone, a scattered ring of flat stones in the open grass below

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG windswept meadow with a weathered white marble stag statue on a low circular plinth, one antler broken, lichen in the carved fur, dry golden grass bending around the base and a scattered ring of flat stones. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the statue dominates the upper half over open grass.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the stag keeps the upper band and the open grass ring stays clear across the lower foreground.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
